pairs.summary: MXI1 and TGIF2 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 4 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Endothelial (Exocrine Tissues); Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Macrophage (General)). Median lift 1.49x, typical spacing ~52 bp between sites. In 4 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
